page.layout: One printed page, blank apart from handwriting and stamps. No printed text blocks, margins or notes.
page.notes: The page carries a handwritten inscription in brown ink in the centre and upper area, dated "Genevae ... anno salutis nostrae millesimo octingentesimo decimo octavo, Pridie Kalendas Julias", signed "Robertus Traill". Handwriting is not transcribed. A blue oval library stamp ("LA RÉFORMATION ... GENÈVE") sits at the upper left and is not transcribed. Faint show-through of a printed title page from the reverse side (fragments such as "DE ... TIA ... CRAE...", a printed device and imprint lines near the bottom) is visible through the paper and is not transcribed.
